content.text: Absence confirmed — no transition, data return, or deletion language exists. Let me validate the insertion.

input.summary: Insert transition assistance, data return and certified deletion obligations in Section 6 (Termination).
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 6 covers notice and final fees but says nothing about exit: we have no right to wind-down help and no assurance our data and Confidential Information come back or are deleted. We have added a new Section 6(c) giving us up to six months of transition assistance at Contractor's then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is an issue, we can accept ninety days of assistance provided the thirty-day export and deletion certificate remain.

ops.text: (c) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason, Contractor shall (i) at Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Contractor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return to Company all Works, Confidential Information and other Company data and materials then in Contractor's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all such Confidential Information, data and materials from its systems and certify such deletion to Company in writing.
